### Observed differences

- Participation itself is unchanged: A26, A27, A35, A36, A41 and A42 occur together in every trace in both windows (co-occurrence 100 in 100 for all eight measured pairs), so the differences lie in routing and order, not in whether the activities run. [REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008]
- In the earlier window, A26's outgoing transitions spread almost evenly over A35, A36, A41 and A42 (about 24–25 in 100 each). In the later window, about 94 in 100 of A26's outgoing transitions go to A30, and A30 immediately follows A26 in about 94 in 100 of the observed pairs, whereas before the pair was always five positions apart (177 traces). [DIR002, LAG002]
- The four activities A35, A36, A41 and A42 rerouted their exits: before, roughly 21–31 in 100 of each one's outgoing transitions went to A30; in the later window this is down to about 0–1 in 100, while new transitions to A27 carry about 17–29 in 100 of each one's outgoing transitions. [DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006]
- These successor changes show up directly in near-distance pairs: A35→A27, A36→A27 and A41→A27 within five steps, seen in only 1–2 earlier traces, occur in about 195–196 of 200 later traces; A35→A30, A41→A30 and A42→A30 within five steps, seen in all 200 earlier traces, remain in only 4–5 later traces. [LAG005, LAG007, LAG008, LAG006, LAG009, LAG010]
- The order between A26/A27 and the four activities reversed. Before, A26 preceded each of A35, A36, A41, A42 in about 98 in 100 traces and A27 preceded each of them in about 96–97 in 100; in the later window each group activity precedes A26 in about 96–98 in 100 traces and precedes A27 in about 96–98 in 100 traces. [REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008]
- A25 now reaches A27 through the group: before, A27 immediately followed A25 in about 97 in 100 cases; in the later window A25's transitions go into the group (about 22–25 in 100 to each of A35, A36, A41, A42, only about 2 in 100 to A27), and A27 comes five positions after A25 in about 97 in 100 of the 180 later traces where the pair occurs within five steps. [DIR001, LAG001]
- Relative event positions shifted consistently: A26's mean relative position moved from about 0.51 to 0.62 and A27's from about 0.37 to 0.48 (both later), while A35, A36, A41 and A42 moved earlier, from about 0.58 to about 0.42. [POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006]
- Minor: within the group, A42 reaches A36 somewhat more spread out (immediately in about 53 in 100 earlier vs 35 in 100 later cases), and a few one-off transitions (about 1 in 200) appear on either side. [LAG011, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the group A35, A36, A41, A42 — which still always executes together, without a fixed internal order, in both windows — now runs before A27 and A26 rather than after them, with the surrounding flow rewired: in the earlier window A25 led directly to A27, A26 branched into the group, and the group exited to A30; in the later window A26 feeds A30 directly, the group exits to A27, and A25 reaches A27 only after passing through the group. [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, LAG001, LAG002, LAG005, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008, LAG009, LAG010, POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006]

This is a reversal of ordering constraints plus rerouting, not merely existing paths being taken with different shares: the order fractions flip from about 96–98 in 100 to about 2 in 100 for all eight measured pairs, the successor profiles change wholesale, and participation stays complete, which rules out a pure participation or rare-variant reading. The 31 flagged items are about 40 times the number expected without a change (0.76), and each difference exceeds those arising in about 199 of 200 random re-splits; the items converge on one coherent rerouting rather than independent effects. [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG005, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008, LAG009, LAG010, LAG011]

Limitations: the order between A26 and A27 themselves was not measured, so their relative position in the later sequence (A26 sits latest, at mean relative position about 0.62) is inferred only indirectly, and the evidence cannot rule out that additional reordering occurred outside the measured pairs; some vanished edges also rest on only 4–5 later observations, though the successor profiles corroborate them. [POS001, POS002, REL001, LAG003, LAG004, LAG006, LAG009, LAG010, DIR002]

Other differences: the slightly wider A42→A36 distances within the group and the scattered one-off transitions (about 1 in 200) are not part of this hypothesis and are consistent with sampling noise. [LAG011, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005]

We have 200 traces before, 200 after. Screening: 153 units tested, 0.76 items expected without change. We have 27 evidence items — that's many times larger than 0.76, so the count cannot be explained by chance as a whole. So we move past the "insufficient evidence" screening check.

Now let's understand the behavioural story.

Key activities: A25, A26, A27, A30, A35, A36, A41, A42.

DIR001 (A25's outgoing transitions): Before, A25 → A27 about 97.5% of the time. After, A25's outgoing transitions are spread: A42 ~25%, A36 ~22%, A35 ~25%, A41 ~25%, A27 ~2%. So A25 used to be followed almost always by A27; in the later window it's followed by one of A35/A36/A41/A42 roughly equally.

DIR002 (A26's outgoing): Before, A26 → A41 ~25%, A35 ~25%, A42 ~24%, A36 ~24% (spread among four). After, A26 → A30 ~94%. So A26 used to fan out to four activities; now it goes almost always to A30.

DIR003 (A35's outgoing): Before, A35 → A36 ~29%, A42 ~23%, A30 ~22%, A41 ~25%. After, A35 → A36 ~26%, A42 ~23%, A41 ~21%, A27 ~26%, A30 ~1.5%. So A35's transition to A30 nearly disappeared and a transition to A27 appeared (~26%).

DIR004 (A36's outgoing): Before, A36 → A30 ~22%, A41 ~26%, A42 ~20%, A35 ~29%. After, A36 → A42 ~29%, A27 ~29%, A30 ~1%, A35 ~18%, A41 ~21%. So A36→A30 nearly disappeared; A36→A27 appeared (~29%).

DIR005 (A41's outgoing): Before, A41 → A42 ~30%, A30 ~31%, A36 ~16%, A35 ~20%. After, A41 → A30 ~0.5%, A35 ~22%, A36 ~33%, A42 ~21%, A27 ~21%. So A41→A30 nearly disappeared; A41→A27 appeared (~21%).

DIR006 (A42's outgoing): Before, A42 → A35 ~24%, A36 ~27%, A30 ~21%, A41 ~22%. After, A42 → A41 ~28%, A36 ~17%, A35 ~33%, A27 ~17%, A30 ~0%. So A42→A30 disappeared; A42→A27 appeared (~17%).

So the DIR story: In the before window, A26 branched to A35/A36/A41/A42, and each of those went to A30 (about 20-30% each) among other targets. In the after window, A26 goes to A30 directly (~94%), and A35/A36/A41/A42 now go to A27 instead of A30.

POS items:
- POS001 A26: mean relative position 0.51 → 0.62 (later in the trace).
- POS002 A27: mean 0.37 → 0.48 (later).
- POS003 A35: mean 0.58 → 0.42 (earlier).
- POS004 A36: 0.58 → 0.42 (earlier).
- POS005 A41: 0.58 → 0.42 (earlier).
- POS006 A42: 0.58 → 0.42 (earlier).

So A26 and A27 moved later; A35/A36/A41/A42 moved earlier. This is consistent with a swap of block positions: the block {A35,A36,A41,A42} used to sit after A26 (positions ~0.58) and A27 before (~0.37); afterwards the block sits earlier (~0.42) and A27 later (~0.48), A26 later (~0.62).

REL items:
- REL001-004: A26 vs A35/A36/A41/A42: before, A26 before B ~98%; after, B before A ~96-97.5%. So the order between A26 and each of the four reversed.
- REL005-008: A27 vs A35/A36/A41/A42: before, A27 before B ~96-97%; after, B before A ~96-97.5%. So order between A27 and each of the four reversed.

Co-occurrence stays 1.0 in all — the activities still occur together in every trace.

That means the pair A26 then A41 within 5 steps occurred in only 4 traces in the after window. Hmm, but REL003 says co-occurrence 1.0 — A26 and A41 co-occur in all traces. But the ordered pair A26→A41 within 5 steps only in 4 traces after. That's consistent with A41 now coming before A26 (B_before_A 97.5%), so the ordered pair A26→A41 rarely occurs within 5 steps.

- LAG008 (A41 → A27): before support 2; after 196. New.
- LAG009 (A41 → A30): after support 4 (was 200). Vanished.
- LAG010 (A42 → A30): after support 4 (was 200). Vanished.
